videos.video_subject: When Cristiano Ronaldo signed for Manchester United in 2003 he asked for the number 28 shirt he had worn at Sporting, but Alex Ferguson refused and handed him the iconic number 7 previously worn by George Best, Eric Cantona and David Beckham, and the pressure of that shirt shaped the CR7 brand
videos.video_script: At eighteen he asked for number twenty eight. Ferguson refused, and gave him Beckham's number seven. That weight is what created CR7. Which makes you wonder,
